capabilities: Render existing daily notes as one infinite-scroll timeline, newest first
Search across every daily note with Ctrl/Cmd+F
Jump to any dated note or scroll back to the newest
Fold headings and lists, show properties and linked mentions per note
Reshape wide tables, Bases, and embeds as cards on phones and tablets
disambiguation: Not a daily-notes editor; the stream is strictly read-only for reading, and to edit you open the note itself.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.14.4 or later. Manual installs can be verified with GitHub CLI attestations. States it collects no telemetry; on mobile, YouTube embeds load preview images from i.ytimg.com.
intentEvidence: It works with the daily notes you already have. There's no new folder, format, or template to set up
problem: Obsidian stores daily notes as separate files that must be opened one at a time, with no continuous view for reading through years of them as a journal.

relations.evidence: the stream uses Periodic Notes' folder and format instead
With the Calendar plugin open, the day you're reading is highlighted as you scroll
Templates made with the core Templates plugin or with Templater both work
Dataview tables and Bases are shown the way Obsidian shows them
Thank you to the authors and maintainers of the projects that inspired this plugin

requires.name: Obsidian core Daily notes, or Periodic Notes with daily notes enabled

summary: Read-only journal timeline that shows all existing daily notes on one scrolling page with infinite scroll, search, and jump-to-date.
